g.text: Exact saved consensus footprints explain both the prevailing pattern and its exceptions
These are illustrative events from the fixed 8/4 study, selected near each image mean. Full polygons are retained; no coordinates or orders are edited.
The hard-image GT itself is not camera-star-shaped. It remains a valid frozen reference under the official research scoring contract.
